name: orch8/sdk
description: PHP SDK for the Orch8 durable workflow engine: typed REST client, forking worker, push-dispatch verifier and a Laravel-style jobs API.

suggest.ext-pcntl: Required for concurrent (forked) task execution and graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT shutdown in Orch8\Worker\Worker
suggest.ext-posix: Used by forked task processes to exit without running shared destructors
